subject.title: [Feature]: Support for Custom Emojis in Latest Telegram Bot API Update

question: What permanent API shape should OpenClaw expose for Telegram custom emoji delivery: raw Telegram `entities` and `caption_entities`, a portable rich-text/custom-emoji IR, or Telegram-only channel data?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing entity arrays changes shared message-tool and plugin API shape, while the current formatter already supports a partial HTML passthrough path.

options.title: Design Shared Rich-Text Entity API
options.body: Add a typed representation that can carry custom emoji IDs through the shared message tool and let Telegram map it to Bot API entities or safe HTML.

options.title: Expose Telegram-Only Entities
options.body: Add a narrow `channelData.telegram.entities` and `caption_entities` path with Telegram-specific validation and tests.

options.title: Keep HTML-Only Support
options.body: Declare `<tg-emoji>` HTML passthrough the supported path and keep raw entity-array requests out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Rich-Text Entity API
recommendation.body: Add a typed representation that can carry custom emoji IDs through the shared message tool and let Telegram map it to Bot API entities or safe HTML.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review and local history make steipete the strongest API-shape routing candidate for this shared message-tool and Telegram plugin boundary.
